description_en: Creates and attaches tags to a specified list of resources
description_zh: 为指定的资源列表创建并绑定标签
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

EgressProxyGateway: egress proxy gateway instance
EgressProxyIpPool: egress proxy IP address pool
EgressProxyConfiguration: egress proxy configuration
EgressProxyRuleGroup: egress proxy rule group
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型，取值：

EgressProxyGateway：出口代理网关实例。
EgressProxyIpPool：出口代理地址池。
EgressProxyConfiguration：出口配置。
EgressProxyRuleGroup：出口规则组
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The list of resource IDs. You can specify up to 50 resource IDs in a single call
parameters.help_zh: 资源 ID 列表。一次调用最多支持输入 50 个资源 ID
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en: The tag key. The key can be up to 128 characters in length, cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签键。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The value can be up to 256 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。最多支持256个字符，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. You can specify up to 20 tags in a single call
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表。一次调用最多支持输入 20 个标签
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run and does not attach tags to resources. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and service limits are met. If the request fails the dry run, an error is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.

false (default): does not perform a dry run. The system sends a normal request. If the request passes the check, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会添加资源标签。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误；如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回 HTTP 2xx 状态码并直接执行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

Note If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端 Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符。

说明 若您未指定，则系统自动使用 API 请求的 RequestId 作为 ClientToken 标识。每次 API 请求的 RequestId 不一样
parameters.name: client_token
